title: Oozy Gooey Moroccan Almonds Amlou
description: A traditional Moroccan dessert made with almonds, honey, and apple juice, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This pescatarian-friendly treat is both bitter and gooey, with a rich, velvety texture.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the sliced almonds and honey over low heat, stirring constantly until the honey is melted and the almonds are well coated.
Add the apple juice, orange blossom water, and rose water to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has thickened and the almonds are caramelized.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the sea salt.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then transfer it to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the amlou chilled, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
